title: Enhanced Strength of a Mechanical Alloyed NbMoTaWVTi Refractory High Entropy Alloy
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying of elemental powders (Nb, Mo, Ta, W, V, Ti) in a high energy planetary ball mill for 40 hours at ball-to-powder weight ratio of 13:1 under argon atmosphere, followed by spark plasma sintering at 1400°C for 10 minutes under 30 MPa pressure with heating rate of 100°C/min and cooling rate of 300°C/min to 500°C
